environment.hardware: 20 CPU affinity workers; CPU only; NVIDIA RTX 5090 not used because this low-dimensional fit completed in 6.36 s

likelihood_and_model.data: Released DESI DR2 13-row Gaussian BAO mean vector and full 13x13 covariance in unchanged published order; covariance Cholesky-positive
likelihood_and_model.observables: DM/rd, DH/rd, and DV/rd; includes older Ly-alpha BAO rows at z=2.33
likelihood_and_model.model: Late-time curved LCDM; E^2=Omega_m(1+z)^3+Omega_k(1+z)^2+Omega_Lambda; Omega_Lambda=1-Omega_m-Omega_k; S_k uses sinh for Omega_k>0, sin for Omega_k<0, flat limit at zero
likelihood_and_model.amplitude: alpha=c/(H0 rd), independently profiled and dimensionless; neither H0 nor rd separately identified
likelihood_and_model.radiation: Omitted, as in the campaign's low-z background screen; not a full early-universe-calibrated fit
likelihood_and_model.optimizer: 16 deterministic L-BFGS-B starts, a 61x61 grid/refinement and a 64-start observed optimum stability check; mocks repeated the fixed 16-start flat/curved search. Failed statuses and bounded Powell rechecks are retained.
likelihood_and_model.null: Fitted flat-LCDM Gaussian parametric null: recreate and fit 200+1000 disjoint-seed full-covariance mocks (PCG64 seeds 20260924 and 20260925); compare Delta-chi2=chi2_flat-chi2_curved with the observed value using the same finite search. This is a search-specific bootstrap frequency, not a posterior p-value or discovery significance.

independent_review: Separate scalar adaptive-quadrature implementation checked curved-FRW signs, dimensions, GLS alpha profiling, flat limit, nested bounds, data order, E^2 positivity and fit scores. Chi-square differences to primary screen are below 3.1e-13. The independent 3-parameter direct L-BFGS-B diagnostic for the [-0.10,0.10] case returned ABNORMAL at iteration 0 despite objective equality to the GLS-profiled optimum; rely on the independent successful profile/grid path for that fit and retain its status as a diagnostic failure.
limitations: Exploratory late-time background-only profile screen, not posterior or Bayesian evidence.
No radiation, early-universe ruler calibration, massive neutrinos, perturbations, growth, CMB, SNe or lensing.
Parameter limits are numerical search bounds, not priors; multi-start/grid checks do not prove globality.

The 13-row vector contains the old DESI DR2 Ly-alpha BAO representation; latest Results IV uses the same sample family and cannot be appended independently without a replacement joint covariance/likelihood.
next_test: Obtain and audit the official DR2 Ly-alpha Results IV replacement/joint likelihood and covariance; until then, an exact one-rate physically motivated background model (with matched mock-selection calibration and explicit perturbation limitations) is the strongest executable BAO-only follow-up.
